BulkVerificationDecisionRequest.description:
Shared shape for the four bulk verification endpoints (business
approve/reject, freelancer approve/reject) — each controller passes its
own permission via a route-bound check, so authorization here only
confirms the caller holds *some* verification-approval permission; the
per-item Action still enforces the pending-state guard.
BulkVerificationDecisionRequest.title: BulkVerificationDecisionRequest

BusinessVerificationStatus.description: Shared by businesses.verification_status and business_documents.verification_status — a document's verification is part of the same admin review as the business itself.
BusinessVerificationStatus.title: BusinessVerificationStatus

reason.description:
CancelBooking::handle() is the source of truth for "required
 when the actor is the provider" — the FormRequest can't know
which side of the booking is calling until the Action checks.

NotificationCategory.description: Groups the SRS §11 notification events into the categories users toggle in `notification_preferences` (one row per user per category). In-app is always on for every category and is not represented here — it isn't a preference, it's the floor.
NotificationCategory.title: NotificationCategory

amount.description:
Amount-vs-threshold and amount-vs-payment-total checks live in
IssueRefund (the enforcing copy) — omitting it here refunds
the full payment.

RequestUploadUrlRequest.description:
`attachable_type` is intentionally a short allow-list, not every
registered morph alias — only domains without their own dedicated
presign flow (business documents, deliverables) belong here. Currently
just dispute evidence, since disputes have no other upload path.
RequestUploadUrlRequest.title: RequestUploadUrlRequest

scheduled_date.description:
Mirrors CreateBookingRequest::assertNotInThePast — the Action
is still the source of truth (it also checks the time slot
against "now" when the date is today).

milestones.description:
The Action is the source of truth for "sums to the contract
 total" — it needs the parsed Money values to compare
precisely (StoreProjectRequest precedent).

budget_min.description:
The Action is the source of truth for "min <= max" and
">0" (it needs the parsed Money values to compare precisely).

discount_amount.description:
Deliberately no 'total_amount'/'platform_fee'/'tax_amount' rule —
those are never accepted from the client (CLAUDE.md §2/§17),
and any such field in the payload is silently ignored by the
SendQuotation action, which recomputes them itself.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
